task_text: Sliding receive, inertial staging and moving hand-off: At the start a small cube slides along a raised, slippery lane toward its open end. Receive it in the shallow tray the Panda holds (open on one side) once it has left the lane and let it settle; then, keeping the tray level, make the cube slide inside the tray by moving the tray (tilting is not allowed) until it rests at a staging point; carry it through two waypoints; bring the tray to a pose at a fixed offset from a platform that slides slowly back and forth on a rail while matching its velocity; finally get the cube onto that platform, where it must ride along at rest without touching the tray. Phases, in order: source_to_tray: the cube (which has touched the lane, as it starts on it) is supported by the tray (touched it within the last 25 ms), does not touch the lane, has its centre at world x > 0.12 m, and moves at less than 0.05 m/s relative to the tray, for 0.10 s without interruption. The cube's position in the tray frame at that moment is recorded as its received position.; inertial_staging: the tray must stay level throughout this phase: tilting its z axis more than 2.1 deg from world vertical fails the task (tilt_only_shortcut). (a) At some physics step of this phase the horizontal (world x-y) acceleration of the Panda TCP, taken as the 1 ms difference of its velocity, must exceed 0.540 m/s^2; (b) at or after that step the cube's tray-frame x-y position must be more than 0.025 m away from its received position. After both, the cube must rest at the staging point: supported by the tray, its tray-frame x-y within `target_tolerance` = 0.014 m of (`target_offset`, 0) = (0.03, 0) m, moving at less than 0.045 m/s relative to the tray, for 0.3 s without interruption.; transport_turn: with the cube supported by the tray, the tray's frame origin comes within 0.022 m of waypoint A = (0.08, 0.13, 0.22), then within 0.022 m of waypoint B = (0.19, 0.20, 0.22), in this order.; match_receiver: at one physics step, all of: the cube is supported by the tray; the tray body's linear velocity differs from the platform's by less than 0.05 m/s; the platform moves at least `receiver_min_speed` (0 at this instance, so this adds nothing); and the tray's frame origin is within 0.012 m of the point offset (0.34, 0, 0.008) m, in world axes, from the centre of the platform's top surface (0.34 m in +x and 8 mm above it).; support_transfer: the cube touches the platform, is not supported by the tray (no cube-tray contact within the last 25 ms), its centre is within 0.07 m of the platform's centre along both world x and world y, and its velocity differs from the platform's by less than 0.045 m/s, for 0.5 s without interruption. This completes the task. Goal geometry: Receive line: cube centre at world x > 0.12 m (source_to_tray). Staging point in the tray frame: (0.03, 0) m, tolerance 0.014 m. Waypoint A (0.08, 0.13, 0.22) and waypoint B (0.19, 0.20, 0.22) for the tray's frame origin, tolerance 0.022 m. Match pose: platform top-surface centre + (0.34, 0, 0.008) m, tolerance 0.012 m.
